MR Safety
The Cobalt Aneurysm Clip is MR Conditional. A person with the Cobalt Aneurysm Clip may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Cobalt Aneurysm Clip
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5-Tesla
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 25 T/m (2,500 gauss/cm)
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
RF Excitation Circularly Polarized (CP)
RF Conditions B1+RMS of 2.8 microtesla or less; if B1+rms is not available, limit whole-body SAR to 2 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 20 minutes. A cooling period of 15 minutes is required between scans.
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 15 mm from the device.
